people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am Yahweh, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.
translations.bsb: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
translations.kjv: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
translations.asv: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am Jehovah your God, and there is none else; and my people shall never be put to shame.
